name: Whalien 52
album: 화양연화 The Most Beautiful Moment in Life pt.2

lines.lyric: The most lonely creature in the world
lines.lyric_hangul: The most lonely creature in the world

lines.lyric: Do you wanna know my story? (Yeah)
lines.lyric_hangul: Do you wanna know my story? (Yeah)

lines.lyric: I never told this to anybody
lines.lyric_hangul: I never told this to anybody

lines.lyric_translation: In the middle of the vast ocean

lines.lyric: Han mari goraega najeumakhi oeropge mareul hae
lines.lyric_hangul: 한 마리 고래가 나즈막히 외롭게 말을 해
lines.lyric_translation: One whale speaks softly and lonelily
The fact that no matter how much they shout, it won’t reach
Makes them so gravely lonely that they quietly shut their mouths

lines.lyric_hangul: 아무렴 어때 뭐가 됐던 이젠 뭐, I don't care
lines.lyric_translation: Now, well, I don’t care / When only the thing called

parts.lyric: Dwaetdeon ijen mwo I don’t care

lines.lyric: Oeroumiran nyeoseokman nae gyeoteseo meomul ttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 외로움이란 녀석만 내 곁에서 머물 때
lines.lyric_translation: Loneliness remained by my side

lines.lyric: Onjeonhi honjaga dwae oeroi chaeuneun jamulsoe
lines.lyric_hangul: 온전히 혼자가 돼 외로이 채우는 자물쇠
lines.lyric_translation: I’ve become completely alone

lines.lyric: Nugun malhae saekki yeonyein da dwaetne
lines.lyric_hangul: 누군 말해 새끼 연예인 다 됐네
lines.lyric_translation: Some say, “bastard, you’ve become a celebrity”

lines.lyric: Oh fuck that, geurae mwo eottae nugunga gyeote
lines.lyric_hangul: Oh, fuck that, 그래, 뭐 어때 누군가 곁에
lines.lyric_translation: Oh fuck that, yeah, well, so what, nobody

lines.lyric: Meomul su eobtda handaedo geugeollo jokhae
lines.lyric_hangul: 머물 수 없다 한대도 그걸로 족해
lines.lyric_translation: remains by my side, I’m ok like this

lines.lyric_hangul: 날 향해 쉽게 얘기하는 이 말은 곧 벽이 돼
lines.lyric_translation: These words that are easily said / towards me quickly becomes a wall
Even loneliness turns into something you can see
Even if my breaths are blocked
Because I’m confined in that wall
I head towards the surface of water above

lines.lyric: Hey oh, oh hey oh yeah
lines.lyric_hangul: Hey, oh, oh, hey, oh, yeah
lines.lyric_translation: Hey oh oh hey oh yeah
Lonely lonely lonely whale
Singing alone like this
Even me, who’s like a lonely island
Can I shine on the outside
Lonely lonely lonely whale
Like this, try calling once again
Until this song that doesn’t have a response
Reaches tomorrow
No more no more baby
No more no more

lines.lyric: Kkeuteobtneun mujeon hana eonjenga daheul geoya
lines.lyric_hangul: 끝없는 무전 하나 언젠가 닿을 거야
lines.lyric_translation: An endless signal, will reach someday
Everywhere, even to the other side of the earth
No more no more baby
No more no more

lines.lyric: Nunmeon goraedeuljocha nal bol su isseul geoya
lines.lyric_hangul: 눈먼 고래들조차 날 볼 수 있을 거야
lines.lyric_translation: Even the blind whales will be able to see me
Today, again, I sing

lines.lyric_hangul: 세상은 절대로 몰라 내가 얼마나 슬픈지를
lines.lyric_translation: The world will never know how sad I am / My pain is water and oil that can’t mix

lines.lyric: Nae apeumeun seokkil su eobtneun mulgwa gireum
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 아픔은 섞일 수 없는 물과 기름
lines.lyric_translation: So only above the surface of the water do I
Breathe, and the interest towards me ends

lines.lyric: Sumeul swil ttae gwansim kkeut oeroun badassok kkoma
lines.lyric_hangul: 숨을 쉴 때 관심 끝 외로운 바닷속 꼬마
lines.lyric_translation: A child in the lonely ocean. I want to make it known too

lines.lyric: Nado alligo sipne nae gachireul Everyday
lines.lyric_hangul: 나도 알리고 싶네 내 가치를 every day
lines.lyric_translation: My value, everyday

lines.lyric: Geokjeongui meolmireul hae neul seutikeoneun gwi mite
lines.lyric_hangul: 걱정의 멀미를 해, 늘 스티커는 귀 밑에
lines.lyric_translation: I become sick with worry, the sticker always beneath my ear

lines.lyric: Never end, wae kkeuteun eobtgo maebeon hell
lines.lyric_hangul: Never end, 왜 끝은 없고 매번 hell
lines.lyric_translation: Never end, why isn’t there an end; every time it’s hell

lines.lyric: Sigani gado chagaun simyeon sogui Neverland
lines.lyric_hangul: 시간이 가도 차가운 심연 속의 neverland
lines.lyric_translation: Even if time goes by, in the cold abyss. Neverland
But, I always think, now
Even if I sleep a shrimp’s sleep,

Believe in my hertz
